name: Skillingaryd - Åsafors
description: Skillingaryd to Åsafors. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official section title says Skillingaryd - Åsafors, but the actual HÖ21/HÖ22 main-trail node and GPX start are at Grönelund west of Skillingaryd. Skillingaryd station is an access connector, not the mainline endpoint.

Official text indicates Åsafors is near road access and pickup/dropoff is possible, but also says there is no direct parking. Transit lane found no fixed-route Åsafors stop and nearest sparse line-254 stops are about 9 km away.
Rules lane reported Länsstyrelsen Jönköping rendered an open-burning-prohibition heading, while the official municipal fire-ban map service reported Inget eldningsförbud for Vaggeryd and Gnosjö.
Kylås appears as an official nearby object and lies on the HÖ22 corridor, but Naturkartan/Kylås sources describe it as bookable/private and not Smålandsleden-managed.
Bissefäll is municipality-confirmed bookable lodging, while nearby Hagstad Raststuga has OSM/Vindskyddskartan evidence but is absent from official HÖ22 nearby places.
OSM relation 15427025 spans Grönelund-Kärringabacka, combining HÖ22 and HÖ23, and has non-navigation-grade member ordering.

Explicitly not Smålandsleden-managed and bookable/private. Do not model as a free public shelter, public toilet, public drinking water or public bathing place. Kylås private farm trails/gates should not be imported as public HÖ22 assets.

facilities.name: Skillingaryd station and connector
facilities.description: Official public-transport access via the unmarked Skillingaryd station connector to Grönelund. Not a HÖ22 mainline facility. Station parking is up to 24 h only; Grönelund is preferred for trailhead parking.
